override.name: director_6wave_tuned
override.note: Director's final 6-wave layout tuned for the average party (15-20 min at 15 s/turn, ~1 run in 5 wiping once; Captain + Sealwright the hardest wave). Per-enemy: crew (Deck Warden, Skyglass Sentinel, First Blade, Oathkeeper, Wayfinder) poolsMultiplier 1.0 = 5,050 HP, innate damage given = two rows of +100% (engine caps a percentage row at 100; rows multiply, x4); Core Horror (stage boss) poolsMultiplier 5 = 25,250 HP, two +100% rows; The Captain and Sealwright poolsMultiplier 2.5 = 12,625 HP, three +100% rows (x8); Seal Charge as captured (level 70, 3,550 HP) with Core Rupture v2. All values storable; set via scaleEditedAi.

variants.note: director's endgame party member (2026-10-28): level-100 JONIN, stats at the JONIN caps, full Kitsune armour set (6 captured pieces, worn through the engine's item path), 9 PvE jutsu at the level cap 25, Fire/Wind elements
